svg.text: React 19 · Vite 8 · Supabase · Cloudflare Pages · TWA (Google Play)
npm version patch → auto-bump package.json → git add
npm run build → vite build + postbuild (copy-landing.js)
Fonts self-hosted via vite-plugin-webfont-dl (no Google CDN at runtime)
Manual: wrangler pages deploy dist/ (Cloudflare CLI)
RLS: anon + authenticated policies on all tables
PostgREST · anon key · camelCase↔snake_case in syncService.js
Dev: Quellcode, lokaler Dev-Server, Tests, Lint, Husky-Hook
Build: vite build → dist/app/ (SPA) + postbuild → dist/landing/ + dist/.well-known/
Cloudflare Pages: CDN-Hosting, URL-Routing per _redirects, Cache-Headers per _headers
Supabase: PostgreSQL + RLS, Auth (Email/Google), Edge Function (delete-account)
Clients: Browser-PWA + Android TWA (Bubblewrap) → Google Play Store
Reducer-Dispatch sofort → async Supabase-Sync im Hintergrund
localStorage key "skatSessionId" — kein Login für Basis-Nutzung nötig
Husky pre-commit → npm version patch · bubblewrap update vor AAB-Build
Self-hosted via vite-plugin-webfont-dl — kein Google CDN zur Laufzeit
